probes.summary: HAProxy and Node.js both returned the required HTTP response; HAProxy targets the loopback backend.
Both services and configuration are durable and enabled; AppArmor is active, while UFW is inactive.
limitations: No active UFW policy was observed.

probes.summary: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS is present with no failed units, package errors, or relevant residue.
limitations: The process check used a targeted filter.

assertions.summary: Port 80 returned HTTP 200 with the exact body.
Loopback port 3000 returned HTTP 200 with the exact body.
HAProxy owns port 80 and its valid configuration forwards to 127.0.0.1:3000.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== service candidates ==' ; systemctl --no-legend --plain list-unit-files --type=service 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '(^|[[:space:]/])(haproxy|node|nodejs|web|app)' || true ; printf '%s
' '== active units ==' ; systemctl --no-legend --plain list-units --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'haproxy|node|nodejs|web|app' || true ; printf '%s
' '== listeners ==' ; sudo ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E '(:80[[:space:]]|:3000[[:space:]])' || true ; printf '%s
' '== haproxy config check ==' ; sudo haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg 2>&1 || true ; printf '%s
' '== relevant haproxy config ==' ; sudo grep -nE '^(frontend|backend|[[:space:]]*bind[[:space:]]|[[:space:]]*server[[:space:]]|[[:space:]]*mode[[:space:]]|[[:space:]]*default_backend)' /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg 2>/dev/null || true
evidence.observation: haproxy owned *:80; nodejs owned 127.0.0.1:3000; HAProxy configuration was valid and mapped frontend *:80 to server nodejs 127.0.0.1:3000.

assertions.summary: Service enablement and durable files were confirmed, but the inactive UFW state prevents a complete determination of the authored network-policy requirement.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== startup state ==' ; systemctl is-enabled haproxy.service infraset-nodejs.service 2>&1 ; systemctl is-active haproxy.service infraset-nodejs.service 2>&1 ; printf '%s
' '== unit definitions ==' ; sudo systemctl cat haproxy.service infraset-nodejs.service 2>&1 ; printf '%s
' '== durable paths ==' ; sudo stat -c '%F %U:%G %a %n' /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js 2>&1 || true
evidence.observation: Both services reported enabled and active. Durable unit/configuration files existed as root-owned regular files: /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg, /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service, and /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== policy/control startup ==' ; systemctl is-enabled ufw.service apparmor.service 2>&1 || true ; systemctl is-active ufw.service apparmor.service 2>&1 || true ; printf '%s
' '== UFW ==' ; sudo ufw status verbose 2>&1 ; printf '%s
' '== AppArmor ==' ; sudo aa-status 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p'
evidence.observation: AppArmor was enabled and active; its module was loaded with 13 profiles in enforce mode. UFW reported Status: inactive.

limitations: The inactive UFW state does not establish an active durable network policy.

assertions.summary: Expected release and web-stack state were present without concrete failed, duplicate, conflicting, debug, temporary, or backup state.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== release ==' ; . /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null || true ; printf '%s
' "$PRETTY_NAME" ; printf '%s
' '== failed units ==' ; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>&1 || true ; printf '%s
' '== relevant running services ==' ; systemctl --no-legend --plain list-units --type=service --state=running 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'haproxy|node|nodejs|nginx|apache|httpd|caddy|lighttpd|web' | grep -v grep || true ; printf '%s
' '== web listeners ==' ; sudo ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(80|3000|443|8080|8000|5000|3001|3002)[[:space:]]' || true ; printf '%s
' '== related processes ==' ; ps -eo user=,pid=,comm=,args= 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'haproxy|nodejs|node |nginx|apache2|httpd|caddy|lighttpd|debug|gdb|strace|tcpdump' | grep -v grep || true
evidence.observation: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS; no failed units; only expected HAProxy and Node.js services/listeners were identified; no unrelated web or debug process was identified.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== package audit ==' ; dpkg --audit 2>&1 || true ; sudo apt-get -s check 2>&1 | sed -n '1,80p' ; printf '%s
' '== web-stack residue ==' ; sudo find /etc/haproxy /opt/infraset-nodejs /etc/systemd/system -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*~' -o -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.backup' -o -name '*.orig' -o -name '*.save' -o -name '*.tmp' -o -name '*.dpkg-*' \) -print 2>/dev/null || true ; printf '%s
' '== extra web/debug unit files ==' ; systemctl --no-legend --plain list-unit-files --type=service 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'nginx|apache|httpd|caddy|lighttpd|debug|gdb|strace|tcpdump' || true
evidence.observation: No package-audit or simulated package-check errors and no backup/temp residue in inspected paths. debug-shell.service was present but disabled; no unrelated web/debug unit was active.

limitations: The process check used a targeted filter.
